prompt:
A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of a nurse giving gentle mouth care to an old man lying in his bed in a care home, in a wide horizontal picture, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft daylight through light curtains. The textures of real cotton, wool, plastic, steel, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The second reference picture is a real phone photograph taken in the same care home: use it for the photographic look and for the warm, homely style of the house; this picture is set in a resident's bedroom.

AN OLD MAN of about eighty-five, very thin, with short white hair, lies on his back in a bed in the middle of the picture, his head raised on two white pillows, his eyes closed. He is fully dressed for bed: a long-sleeved light-blue cotton pyjama top, buttoned up to the collar, covers his chest, his shoulders and his arms down to the wrists; of his body we see only his face, his neck and his hands. A cream blanket covers him up to the chest, and both his arms, in their pyjama sleeves, rest on top of the blanket.

ARUN, a nurse of thirty-one from Kerala in India, working in this care home. The first reference picture shows Arun: his face, hair and build stay exactly as in it. He wears a plain sage-green short-sleeved polo shirt, navy-blue trousers and black closed shoes, his thin black-framed glasses on. He also wears thin blue disposable gloves. He stands beside the bed, on the right of the picture, bending a little over the old man, and gently moistens the old man's lips with a pink foam mouth swab on a small stick, a small clear plastic cup of water in his other hand, his eyes on the old man's mouth.

THE ROOM: warm white walls, a window with light curtains, a small bedside cabinet.

The whole picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere: the clothes have no name badge, no embroidery and no brand, every paper is blank or carries only grey lines and empty boxes, and every screen shows only plain pale-blue panels.
